questions.prompt: What is the main risk of running /compact with no instructions?

choices.B: The summary may drop something important and Claude drifts

questions.explanation: Add instructions after the command to say what the summary must keep.

questions.prompt: How do you open the rewind menu?

choices.B: Double-press Esc on an empty prompt

questions.explanation: Every prompt is a checkpoint.

questions.prompt: You had a long setup phase and want to compress it but keep the implementation intact. Which rewind option?

choices.B: Summarize up to here

questions.explanation: "From here" compresses what comes after the checkpoint.

questions.prompt: Why must a /goal condition be observable in the output?

choices.B: The evaluator only reads the transcript, so it can only confirm what appears there (e.g. test results)
choices.C: Goals are shown to the user

questions.explanation: e.g. "all tests in src/billing pass and the type checker reports zero errors".

questions.prompt: Why do long CLAUDE.md files get partly ignored?

choices.A: There is a hard line limit
choices.B: Every line competes for attention; it's guidance, not enforced config
choices.C: Claude only reads the first line

questions.explanation: The leaner the file, the more of it is followed.

questions.prompt: Where should "never push to main" live?

choices.B: In a PreToolUse hook that blocks it

questions.explanation: Hard rules need enforcement, not a request.

questions.prompt: Do @imports reduce the context Claude loads?

choices.A: Yes, imported files load on demand
choices.B: No, they're expanded inline at launch; they only organize

questions.explanation: Use imports to organize, not to shrink.

questions.prompt: Which rule is phrased best?

choices.B: "Don't use default exports."

questions.explanation: Specific, checkable, and names the replacement.

questions.prompt: Why build a verification skill first?

choices.B: It removes the dependency on you remembering to ask for checks

questions.explanation: It fires automatically when changes are done.

questions.prompt: Besides running tests and reading the diff, what does the course's verification skill check?

choices.B: That no test was weakened just to make it pass

questions.explanation: Green tests aren't enough if a test was loosened.

questions.prompt: A must-not-skip rule belongs in...

choices.B: A skill

questions.explanation: CLAUDE.md and skills are instructions; hooks are code that runs.

questions.prompt: Why put a check.sh script in the skill folder?

choices.B: It's executed rather than loaded into context, giving the skill its own tooling cheaply

questions.explanation: Keep SKILL.md lean; heavy material goes in side files.

questions.prompt: Which mode runs everything but has a separate classifier review each action?

choices.B: Auto

questions.explanation: The classifier guards intent.

questions.prompt: Which mode fits a CI pipeline with nobody to approve prompts?

choices.B: Don't ask (only pre-approved tools; others auto-denied)

questions.explanation: Nothing hangs waiting for approval.

questions.prompt: Where is Bypass permissions acceptable?

choices.B: Only inside an isolated container or VM

questions.explanation: It skips all checks.

questions.prompt: Auto mode lets Claude write broken authentication code. Why?

choices.B: The classifier checks intent (danger), not correctness; pair it with a Stop hook running tests

questions.explanation: Intent before, correctness after.

questions.prompt: A hook exits with code 1. What happens?

choices.B: Non-blocking: stderr is logged and Claude carries on

questions.explanation: Use exit 2 to block.

questions.prompt: Which PreToolUse field lets you rewrite a Bash command (e.g. redact a secret) instead of blocking it?

choices.B: updatedInput

questions.explanation: It replaces the whole input, so echo back unchanged fields.

questions.prompt: How do you re-inject context right after a compaction?

choices.B: SessionStart hook with the compact matcher

questions.explanation: Its output goes back into the conversation.

questions.prompt: Which event can refuse to let Claude end its turn?

choices.B: Stop (exit 2)

questions.explanation: Useful to require passing tests.

questions.prompt: Which three things does a routine bundle?

choices.B: A prompt, a repository and connectors (run on a trigger)
choices.D: A Docker image, a script, a cron

questions.explanation: Runs on Anthropic's cloud.

questions.prompt: What is the most frequent recurring schedule for a routine?

choices.B: Hourly

questions.explanation: For more frequent jobs, use something else.

questions.prompt: What does `claude -p` skip by default?

choices.B: Auto-discovery of hooks, skills, plugins, MCP servers and CLAUDE.md

questions.explanation: You get only what you allow explicitly; faster startup.

questions.prompt: With --output-format json --json-schema, where is the schema-matching object?

choices.B: .structured_output

questions.explanation: e.g. jq '.structured_output.functions'.

questions.prompt: Can managed Code Review approve or block a PR?

choices.B: No, it only posts findings; humans decide

questions.explanation: No managed autofix either; use /code-review --fix locally.

questions.prompt: How do you set up the Claude GitHub Action?

choices.B: Run /install-github-app (needs repo admin)

questions.explanation: It installs the app and sets the API key secret.

questions.prompt: What does setting the `prompt` input on the action do?

choices.B: Claude runs automatically on the event instead of waiting for the trigger phrase

questions.explanation: Without it, the action waits for @claude.

questions.prompt: Which claude_args flag caps the agent loop?

choices.B: --max-turns

questions.explanation: Also restrict tools and use a non-prompting permission mode.

questions.prompt: What should you start from when reviewing an unattended run?

choices.B: The diff (/code-review, then git diff)

questions.explanation: A tidy summary can hide an unexpected file change.

questions.prompt: Which hook makes tests a real gate on finishing?

choices.B: A Stop hook that runs tests and exits 2 on failure

questions.explanation: Claude reads the failure and fixes it.

questions.prompt: Why prefer auto mode over bypass for unattended work runs?

choices.B: The classifier still screens dangerous actions

questions.explanation: But correctness still needs verification.

questions.prompt: What is a "cold second opinion"?

choices.B: A fresh session or subagent with no memory of the build reviewing the changes

questions.explanation: It catches what the author rationalized away.

questions.prompt: Why read a plugin's details before installing it?

choices.B: It runs code with your privileges, and its hooks fire on every matching call

questions.explanation: Reviewed isn't the same as trusted.

questions.prompt: A plugin and you both define a PreToolUse hook. What happens?

choices.B: Both fire; hooks stack

questions.explanation: Skills, agents and commands, in contrast, are namespaced.

questions.prompt: Which field is required in .claude-plugin/plugin.json?

choices.B: name

questions.explanation: It namespaces the skills: /plugin-name:skill.

questions.prompt: Where do hooks and MCP configs go in a plugin?

choices.B: hooks/hooks.json and .mcp.json at the plugin root

questions.explanation: Components are discovered by convention.
